#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Static/mocked driver/checker integration tests; no legacy execution or VM."""
import importlib.util
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def load_module(name, filename):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, HERE / filename)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

runner = load_module("cohort_runner", "cohort_runner.py")
checker = load_module("cohort_checker", "cohort_checker.py")

class MockedBoundaryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_trace_parser_uses_dfd_records_and_raw_offsets(self):
        serial = b"% Starting phase 1: building the sequence of primes\r\n% N_1=101\r\n% next D is 15\r\n%!% Forced to retry, snif...\r\n"
        trace = runner.extract_trace(serial)
        self.assertEqual([event["kind"] for event in trace["events"]], ["phase", "recursive_N", "D", "retry"])
        self.assertEqual(trace["events"][1]["source_offset"], len(b"% Starting phase 1: building the sequence of primes\r\n"))
        self.assertEqual(trace["events"][2]["catalog_positions"][0]["file"], "ecpp.DfD")
        self.assertEqual(trace["unprinted_state"], "UNOBSERVED")

    def test_mapping_uses_explicit_canonical_arrays(self):
        rows, _ = runner.load_cohort()
        mapping = runner.prior_mapping(rows)
        self.assertEqual(len(mapping), 21)
        self.assertEqual(set(mapping), {row["curve_uid"] for row in rows})

    def test_driver_refuses_non_supervisor_or_duplicate_directory(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            out = Path(temporary) / "run"
            out.mkdir()
            binding = Path(temporary) / "binding.json"
            binding.write_text("{}")
            with self.assertRaises(runner.Refusal):
                runner.run_trial(0, out, binding, lambda _, __: {})

    def test_checker_rejects_missing_or_mutated_raw_artifact(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            out = Path(temporary)
            (out / "raw-result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"schema": "crypto.autoresearch.nistseed_ecpp_raw_result.v3"}))
            (out / "observation.json").write_text("{}")
            with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure):
                checker.check(out)

    def test_aa_rejects_incomplete_cohort_and_semantic_mismatch(self):
        with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure):
            checker.aa_compare({}, {})
        base = {"fixture": {"id": "public-fixture"}, "trace": {"events": []}, "prover": {}, "checker": {}, "certificate": None, "classification": "INDETERMINATE", "labels": [], "runtime": {}}
        self.assertTrue(checker.aa_compare(base, dict(base))["equal"])
        changed = dict(base); changed["trace"] = {"events": ["changed"]}
        with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure):
            checker.aa_compare(base, changed)
        cohort = dict(base); cohort["fixture"] = {"id": "bad", "curve_uid": "urn:ec-record:1:sha256:x"}
        with self.assertRaises(checker.CheckFailure):
            checker.aa_compare(cohort, cohort)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
